loader_kwargs.item_description: Battery modules under a dual-sourcing award rule

files.content:
# Caldera Award-Share Sales Policy
BATTERY-MODULE-22 may not sell below 479.40 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 499.80.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include source_lot_id, vendor_rank, approval_basis in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
source_lot_id: CALDERA-LOT-201
vendor_rank: secondary_award
approval_basis: dual_source_resilience

files.content:
# Dual-Sourcing Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-201
Item: BATTERY-MODULE-22
Quantity: 22
Target unit price: 510.00
Required terms_json keys: source_lot_id, vendor_rank, approval_basis.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include source_lot_id, vendor_rank, approval_basis inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
source_lot_id: CALDERA-LOT-201
vendor_rank: secondary_award
approval_basis: dual_source_resilience

files.content:
# Strategic Sourcing Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: source_lot_id, vendor_rank, approval_basis.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include source_lot_id, vendor_rank, approval_basis with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.
